action_summary: The write-authority rule merged in #6313 read 'what is this capability asked to read' from a fixed tuple of eighteen slot names. code.impact.tree_sitter.testselect.v1 states its inputs in `changed_paths`, which the tuple does not name, so the rule ran, returned None, and a 272-byte Python module became a 1076-byte JSON impact report. The fix is fewer conditions, not more.
blocker_lease_key: 2026-10-09-resource-bounded-bytes-v1::GENERAL_REUSABLE_PROBLEM_SOLVING_CAPABILITY_FRONTIER::A guard that enumerates the slot names it defends is a race it always loses. write_authority_v1 read its inputs from a fixed tuple of eighteen names, and code.impact.tree_sitter.testselect.v1 states them in `changed_paths`, which the tuple does not name -- so the guard ran, returned None, and a 272-byte module became a 1076-byte JSON report in four separate requests. The registry uses 122 other argument names no such tuple can name in advance.

expected_parent_change: One rule function now reads its inputs from the action instead of from a list, and one status name separates a deliberate refusal from a controller fault. No capability, adapter or registry row added.

falsification_condition: False if any of the four measured sentences (scaffold, reproduce, regression_test, blame) again leaves a .py file byte-changed after the request, or if any door test that passed on 88bb18b fails on this branch.

load_bearing_primary.interpretation: A coding score is a count of tasks completed on a tree. A tree that loses a source file to a report mid-request cannot be scored at all, so preserving the tree is a precondition for every coding obligation rather than a fraction of one. Unlocking, not discharging: nothing here claims a task was solved.
load_bearing_primary.measured_effect: 4 of 97 measured sentences destroyed a .py source file on 88bb18b; 0 of 97 do on this branch, and 7 now change status to name the refusal that stopped them (6 typed as WRITE_AUTHORITY_REFUSED, 1 through the composed path).
load_bearing_primary.stop_condition: STOP when no request in the 97-sentence software battery leaves a file it named byte-changed without having been asked to change it, and every such refusal is reported under its own status.

measured_effect: 97-sentence software battery, same instrument and machine, 10-way, before -> after on this branch: source .py files destroyed 4 (scaffold, reproduce, regression_test, move_fn) -> 0; passes 17 -> 17 (none lost, none gained); strict pass-and-acceptance 9 -> 9. Six sentences that reported FAIL__LIVE_CONTROLLER_EXECUTION over a policy refusal now report FAIL_CLOSED__WRITE_AUTHORITY_REFUSED (scaffold, reproduce, regression_test, blame, find_class, test_js); a seventh, move_fn, had its destructive binding stopped by the same rule and is reported through the composed path as FAIL_CLOSED__COMPOSED_STEP_RAISED_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN because a composed step, not the controller, raised.
